text:
lauren: kicking off canary deploy for release v3.4.1 in the 21:00 UTC window. tagging run docs and unwind steps. deploy-bot: canary rollout started (33% traffic) — link: https://console.redwood/infer/releases/v3.4.1 :rocket:
cheng: thanks — quick note: automated canary health checks include latency p95, error-rate >0.5% triggers unwind gate.
mike: where's the lightweight unwind choreography doc? don't want to dig through the big runbook during a hot rollback.
lauren: short link: https://internal.redwood/s/uw-proc — it's the one-page unwind checklist, steps 1-5. also pinned in the release thread.
kim: added a condensed abort script to the checklist:```
# emergency unpin
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/deploys/unpin -d '{"route": "text-gen", "version": "v3.3.9"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```
ops-oncall: noted. I'll watch the canary graphs and stand by to execute the unwind anchor if p95 spikes or error rate climbs.
deploy-bot: metric alert: p95=320ms (baseline 180ms), error_rate=0.3% — within tolerance.
cheng: logging note — if we unwind, run `scripts/grab-logs.sh --since 5m` and upload to the incident preserve bucket, helps triage regressions quickly.
mike: also re: version pinning — if we need to cut traffic, prefer pin-to-previous rather than full kill; that keeps throughput stable. command is in the one-pager.
lauren: agreed. pin to v3.3.9 unless we see infra-level failures.
kim: putting the human approval step: @ops-oncall — call it if you see sustained p95 > 400ms for 3 consecutive minutes or error_rate > 1%.
ops-oncall: got it. If I hit that threshold I'll call the unwind and paste the unpin command here, then confirm when routing flips.
cheng: after unwind, follow the postmortem checklist in the longer runbook: links + flakiness metrics + reproduction steps.
lauren: minor: release notes updated with known-change items and fallback plan. tagging product. :white_check_mark:
mike: :thumbsup: if we get past the canary, I'll start the gradual ramp to 100% over 30m.
deploy-bot: canary health steady — p95=210ms, error_rate=0.1%. continuing.
lauren: thanks everyone. keep this thread for live updates and paste any unpin/pin commands here so ops can audit.
